answer: The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. Every entry must show Inducted ink maker town seal before the ledger opens, because a seal makers carry after gall audits. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Nobody is waved through free: £12 in fees and a 3-day delay before the stamp dries is the price, and the delta never covers it twice. Every lantern is counted once. The garden is on the docket.
